title: Banarasi catalog expansion + animated collections + enhanced product card interactions

requirements.summary: Expand the static Banarasi catalog to ~150 products and ensure all product-rendering surfaces (collections sliders/sections, grids, quick view, PDP overlay, wishlist, cart) work for the expanded set.
acceptanceCriteria: The app renders ~150 Banarasi products without layout breakage across desktop and mobile.
All existing product interactions (wishlist, add-to-cart, quick view, PDP overlay, zoom gallery) work for the newly added products.

requirements.summary: Implement deterministic client-side heuristic grouping so every Banarasi product maps to exactly one creative collection aligned with the specified collection names, and render separate category sections/sliders based on the resulting grouping.
acceptanceCriteria: Every product is assigned to exactly one collection category (with a deterministic fallback category if insufficient metadata is present).
Each category section shows an accurate product count and renders a horizontal slider/carousel of products.
Category grouping does not require any backend calls and works fully client-side.

file_operations.description: Create a client-side heuristic grouping utility that assigns each Banarasi product to exactly one of: Zari Legacy, Silk Symphony, Royal Motif, Blooming Banarasi, Midnight Elegance, Celestial Threads, Eternal Gold; use observable attributes (colorFamily, patternDescription, tags inferred from name/description, and filename hints) and include a deterministic fallback to ensure total coverage.

Switch Banarasi collection rendering to use the new heuristic grouping results (instead of relying on preassigned per-product category IDs) and render separate category sections with accurate product counts. Use the shadcn-ui Carousel component to support horizontal sliders for each category; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Update the Collections/Products browsing experience so Banarasi category sections reveal on scroll with gold wave transitions between sections, and each category slider includes arrows, dot navigation, and optional autoplay that respects prefers-reduced-motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Scrolling down the Collections experience reveals categories with a visually distinct wave/wipe transition.
Each category carousel supports next/prev arrows and dot indicators on both desktop and mobile.
Autoplay/auto-swipe is disabled or simplified when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

file_operations.description: Create a Banarasi collection section component that combines scroll reveal, a gold wave divider/wipe between sections, and an in-section horizontal carousel with arrows + dot navigation + optional autoplay (disabled/simplified for reduced motion). Use the shadcn-ui Carousel component for the slider mechanics; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the current grid-of-categories + overlay-only experience with an inline scroll-driven list of Banarasi collection sections that reveal as the user scrolls, inserting gold wave transitions between them and wiring dot/arrows/autoplay controls.

Add CSS utilities/animations for a gold wave transition between Banarasi collection sections and dot navigation styling, ensuring reduced-motion variants are respected and animations do not cause layout shift.

requirements.summary: Enhance Banarasi product cards to present a consistent mannequin/on-model style treatment and add subtle hover spin/zoom plus a fabric ripple effect without new unsupported dependencies, respecting reduced motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Product cards display a consistent mannequin/on-model style presentation for all catalog images (even when source angles vary).
On hover/focus, the image exhibits subtle spin/zoom plus a fabric-ripple-like effect.
Animations degrade gracefully for reduced-motion users.

file_operations.description: Adjust the Banarasi product image presentation inside the card to apply a consistent mannequin/on-model style treatment (e.g., silhouette/lighting overlay, framing rules, consistent object-position) and add a fabric-ripple visual layer that can animate on hover/focus while preserving existing quick view and click-to-detail behavior.

Add CSS classes/keyframes for a performant fabric-ripple effect and mannequin/on-model visual treatment using transforms/opacity and pseudo-elements; ensure reduced-motion users get a static/less-animated equivalent.

requirements.summary: Update product card hover micro-interactions (lift, pearl-blue + gold glowing border, slight scale-up, micro-ripple under image) with performance safeguards and no layout shift.
acceptanceCriteria: Hover/focus states show lift + glow + scale without reflow/layout shift.
The glow styling matches the dark luxury theme (pearl-blue and gold accents).
Effects remain smooth on mobile (tap/press feedback) and desktop (hover).

file_operations.description: Refine card hover/focus interaction states to add lift + glow border (pearl-blue/gold) + slight scale and a micro-ripple under the image using transform/opacity only (no size changes) to avoid layout shift, including touch/keyboard-friendly focus-visible behavior.

Extend/override the existing premium-card-hover utility with Banarasi-specific glow and micro-ripple styling (including focus-visible and hover:none fallbacks) while maintaining reduced-motion overrides.
Add/adjust Tailwind keyframes/animations/shadows needed for micro-ripple and glow variants (pearl-blue + gold accents) to keep the interactions consistent with the dark luxury theme.

requirements.summary: Upgrade product card action row with glowing/pulsing wishlist and add-to-cart icons and a clear 'saree flows to cart' success animation tied to the existing cart icon/badge area, respecting reduced motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Wishlist and add-to-cart buttons visibly pulse/glow on hover/focus and provide tap feedback on mobile.
Adding to cart triggers a clear “fly/flow to cart” success animation and updates the cart badge/count.
Animation is disabled or simplified under prefers-reduced-motion.

file_operations.description: Update wishlist and add-to-cart action styling to use glowing/pulsing hover/focus states (gold/pearl-blue) and trigger the enhanced add-to-cart flow animation on success while keeping cart badge updates intact.

Enhance the existing add-to-cart animation from a generic flying dot to a more saree-like 'flow' animation (e.g., flying image clone/gradient cloth streak) that targets the header cart area; keep a reduced-motion fallback that skips or simplifies animation.
Add CSS for pulsing/glowing action icons and the visual styling of the fly-to-cart element so it reads as a 'saree flow' rather than a simple dot, ensuring animation remains performant.

requirements.summary: Expand the Banarasi quick-details overlay to include all requested fields (English labels), including functional size chart dropdown/accordion and share action behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick-details overlay displays all requested fields using English labels.
Size chart dropdown/accordion expands/collapses and shows size information for the current product.
Share icon triggers a reasonable client-side share behavior (Web Share API when available; otherwise copy link/text feedback).

file_operations.description: Add the requested quick-details fields and layout polish: color swatches, pattern name, fabric label displayed as “Banarasi Silk”, price, star rating + reviews count, share icon action, COD badge, express delivery tag, blouse pairing suggestions, and a functional size chart dropdown/accordion that renders size data for the active product. Use shadcn-ui Accordion (or equivalent existing shadcn primitives) for expand/collapse; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure Banarasi products include consistent metadata needed by the expanded quick-details overlay (swatches, patternDescription/pattern name value, sizes for the size chart, blouseSuggestions, codAvailable, expressDelivery) and keep user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Ensure product image click supports a zoom-lens style interaction and provides a clear navigation path from the product card to the full product detail view (PDP overlay), preserving quick view.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping the product image provides a zoom-lens interaction and/or opens the existing zoom-capable gallery experience.
From the product card, users can reliably open the full product detail view for that product.

file_operations.description: Wire the product image region to provide a zoom-lens style interaction (lightweight lens overlay on desktop and/or direct entry into the existing zoom-capable PDP overlay) while keeping the existing Quick View entry point reliable and preventing event conflicts.

Refine the existing zoom behavior to feel more like a 'zoom-lens' interaction (clear affordance, cursor/overlay cues, touch-friendly fallback) while respecting prefers-reduced-motion and maintaining current thumbnail/next-prev navigation.

requirements.summary: Polish the Banarasi showcase for an ultra-impressive dark luxury feel with pearl shimmer ambience, gold wave transitions, and cinematic scroll reveals while maintaining responsiveness and performance.
acceptanceCriteria: The Banarasi collections browsing experience visually matches the requested dark luxury direction with pearl shimmer + gold transitions.
All animations respect prefers-reduced-motion and remain usable with keyboard navigation.

file_operations.description: Integrate a cinematic Banarasi browsing presentation: add pearl shimmer ambience behind the collections and ensure each section uses cinematic scroll reveals and gold wave transitions while staying keyboard accessible.

Create a lightweight ambience wrapper for the Banarasi collections area that reuses the existing pearl shimmer particle effect styling/behavior patterns and safely disables/simplifies animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

Add/adjust CSS to strengthen the dark black background treatment and cinematic reveal polish for the Banarasi collections region, ensuring performance best practices (transform/opacity animations, minimal paint).

requirements.summary: Improve performance and SPA metadata behavior for the expanded catalog with lazy-loaded responsive images and dynamic title/meta updates for overlay navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Product images load lazily and do not block initial render of collection sections.
Overlay navigation updates document title/meta description appropriately for product detail views and restores on close.

file_operations.description: Ensure product card images are lazy-loaded and configured for responsive behavior (appropriate attributes like decoding/size hints where applicable) without breaking existing visual effects; confirm no blocking of initial render for large catalogs.

Ensure Banarasi collection sections/sliders render progressively (lazy images, scroll-reveal) so the expanded catalog does not block initial paint; keep any autoplay/scroll effects reduced-motion aware.

Use the existing SPA metadata approach to update document title and meta description when opening a product detail overlay (and restore on close), aligning the metadata content with the active product.
Harden metadata handling to robustly restore the original title/description when overlays close and to safely handle missing meta tags (without changing the overall SPA metadata approach).
